title: Watermelon and Avocado Salad with Paneer
description: A refreshing salad with the sweetness of watermelon, creaminess of avocado, and the crunch of toasted coconut, paired with nutty flavored paneer.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the shredded coconut and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the diced watermelon and avocado.
In the same non-stick pan, add the marinated paneer cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides.
Add the cooked paneer to the bowl with watermelon and avocado.
Sprinkle the toasted coconut over the top of the salad.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
